SUNNYBUNCH + MIA’S PLACE

A place to belong.
A future to build.

Good candy, with all profits going to Mia’s Place.

Mia’s Place is the nonprofit we plan to build alongside Sunnybunch, inspired by our daughter Mia, who has autism. Our goal is meaningful paid employment for people with autism and other disabilities, with opportunities to use their strengths and feel part of a team.

We want to create a place where people can build skills, earn an income, and pursue their own goals, with support shaped around each person. The long-term aim is reliable employment and greater stability for employees and their families.

Supporting organizations that help autistic children and their families remains part of our mission. We want that care to extend into opportunities as people grow.

☀︎

Our promise covers 100% of profits—the money remaining after Sunnybunch’s business costs. Mia’s Place is a planned nonprofit, and its employment program is in development.

HOW WE HOPE TO GROW

One mission.
Built in phases.

Our plan is for Sunnybunch and Mia’s Place to grow together: joyful candy, meaningful work, and opportunities built to last.

  1. 01

    First · Build the foundation

    Start with great candy.

    Build Sunnybunch around two sour gummy flavors that people come back to. Develop the Mia’s Place plan with input from people with disabilities and employment specialists.

    The focus: Reliable sales and a practical plan for paid work.

  2. 02

    Next · Start a small pilot

    Open doors to work.

    Begin with a small number of paid roles, accessible training, and individual support. Match work to people’s strengths, interests, and choices, then learn together.

    The focus: Meaningful jobs, shaped by employee feedback.

  3. 03

    Long term · Grow with care

    Make opportunity last.

    Expand employment as the business can sustain it. Work toward dependable schedules, continued support, and room to grow, alongside our charitable giving.

    The focus: Lasting jobs and greater stability for families.

We’re at the beginning. These are planned phases, with timing and scale still to be determined.

BEFORE YOUR FIRST BITE

The little
details.

What comes in a pouch?

Each pouch holds 25 individually packed 20 g sachets of one flavor, for 500 g of candy in total. Each sachet contains 8 sugar-coated gummy suns, for 200 gummies in a pouch. Choose Natural Raspberry or Pineapple Orange Guava; both are sour.

How does Subscribe & Save work?

Choose either flavor and save $5.01 per pouch: $24.99 per 25-sachet pouch, compared with $30.00 for a one-time purchase. The subscription repeats every 30 days, with shipping and applicable tax extra on each delivery. One-time purchases remain available. Subscription checkout is not available yet, so adding a subscription to your bag does not start recurring charges. Renewal and cancellation details will be available before checkout opens.

When will my order ship?

Orders ship the next day from Spanish Fork, Utah. This is our dispatch schedule; delivery time depends on the shipping service and destination.

How much is shipping?

Shipping rates and available destinations are being finalized. Shipping and any applicable tax must be shown before you place an order.

Where can I find ingredients and nutrition?

The final ingredient list, allergen information and nutrition panel are pending. Lower sugar is our formulation goal, with taste as the priority; we’re not making a verified reduced-sugar claim yet.

How are Sunnybunch and Mia’s Place connected?

Sunnybunch is our candy brand, and our commitment is to donate 100% of its profits to Mia’s Place. Profits are the money remaining after Sunnybunch’s business costs. Mia’s Place is the nonprofit we plan to establish, focused on meaningful paid employment and lasting opportunity for people with autism and other disabilities, as well as support for autistic children and families. Its employment program is still in development.

Are the employment opportunities available now?

The employment program is a future goal. We plan to begin with a small number of paid roles, develop individual support with employees and employment specialists, and grow as the business can sustain it. We’ll share opportunities when they’re ready.
